Thanks for the ping — quick summary and a DRAFT we can share with Finnova once Rafael OKs:

Incident classification: low-impact authentication anomaly (no escalation).
Window: 2026-01-12 14:45:30 UTC — 2026-01-12 15:10:45 UTC.
Impact: Elevated 401/403 rates for a subset (~0.7% of active integrations) during the window; most requests retried successfully. No evidence of token theft or unauthorized data access.
Root cause (short): regression in token-refresh backoff introduced in 2026-01-11 patch that caused transient refresh failures under a small concurrency pattern.
Mitigation: emergency rollback of the refresh-backoff change at 2026-01-12 14:58 UTC; applied a conservative retry-throttling fix at 2026-01-12 15:06 UTC.
Timeline (high-level):
- 14:46 UTC: anomaly detected by internal alerting
- 14:48 UTC: engineering triage (Jonas) confirms spike correlates with token_refresh failures
- 14:58 UTC: rollback to previous refresh logic
- 15:06 UTC: deploy fix and monitor for 1 hour
- 16:30 UTC: incident declared contained; postmortem drafted

Customer-facing language (sanitized):
We experienced a short-lived authentication anomaly impacting a small subset of integrations on 2026-01-12. The issue was caused by a regression in the token refresh retry logic. We rolled back the change and applied a fix; there is no evidence of credential compromise or unauthorized access. We have attached a redacted postmortem and a small extract of access logs for your review.

Attachments prepared (redacted):
- redacted_postmortem_20260112.pdf (postmortem with internal IDs removed)
- access_logs_snippet_20260112.csv (sample lines, timestamps, IP prefixes redacted)
- ir_timeline_20260112.txt (plain timeline for audit)

SOC2/SIG availability: we can point Finnova to our SOC2 report (public redact) and provide a narrow audit extract (redacted) for their review. Neha, pls confirm the exact artifact IDs and whether we should route via the compliance portal or send directly.

Recommended next step: Rafael sends the sanitized summary + links to the three attachments and offers a 30-minute sync with our engineering/security team if they want to walk the timeline.

Let me know if you want the draft changed before sending.
